applicability_rule: Configured pairlist, venue, quote currency, and research timeframe scope are external assumptions, never source facts; they must be fixed uniformly before measurement.
field_label_requirement: Every populated value must carry origin=external_assumption and a deterministic value or reference.
freezing_requirements: Every value and referenced data manifest must be declared before the first measured trial in the batch.
The same values must apply to every candidate in the batch unless an explicitly declared non-tunable applicability rule excludes a candidate.
The canonical manifest hash must be included in every measured trial identity and result provenance.
Changing a value that can affect selection creates a new trial and increments the global ledger.
A missing or invalid required value keeps the manifest non-frozen and blocks all backtests.
